Recommended_Pattern: App Shell / Header + Main Workspace + Aside
Style_Priority: Glassmorphism + Flat Design + Soft UI Evolution
Key_Effects: Subtle hover (150-200ms) + Smooth transitions + Focus rings
Anti_Patterns: Excessive animations + Inconsistent card borders + Cluttered navigation

Recommended_Pattern: Split-Pane Layout / Channels or Threads + Active View + Context Panel
Style_Priority: Minimalism & Swiss Style + Soft UI Evolution
Color_Mood: Messenger blue + Online green + Vibrant accents
Typography_Mood: Highly readable sans-serif + Tabular numerals for timestamps
Key_Effects: Typing indicators + Conditional auto-scroll (only when at bottom) + Unread badges + Message reactions + Presence avatars
Anti_Patterns: Forced auto-scroll while user is reading history + Hidden scrollbars + Unlabeled icon buttons + Input freeze on send

Recommended_Pattern: Product Catalog / Filters + Grid + Sticky Cart Drawer
Style_Priority: Minimalism & Swiss Style + Clean Modern E-commerce
Color_Mood: High-contrast brand primary + Vibrant purchase CTA + Clean card white
Typography_Mood: Elegant headings + Clear tabular price numerals
Key_Effects: Image gallery zoom + Quick add-to-cart transition + Toast confirmation + Filter drawer animation
Anti_Patterns: Hidden shipping costs + Ambiguous CTA buttons + Low contrast price text

Recommended_Pattern: Widget Grid / KPI Cards + Trend Graphs + Tabular Breakdowns
Color_Mood: Neutral slate background + High-contrast semantic metric colors (green/amber/red)
Key_Effects: Skeleton loading + Hover tooltips + Metric delta badges + Tab transitions
Anti_Patterns: Decorative charts without labels + Layout shifting during refresh + Unexplained metrics

Recommended_Pattern: Data Table View / Search Bar + Filters + Batch Actions + Slide-over Drawer
Style_Priority: Minimalism & Swiss Style + High-Efficiency Enterprise Clean
Color_Mood: Professional slate + Semantic status colors (Active, Pending, Suspended)
Key_Effects: Row hover highlight + Checkbox selection bar + Slide-out detail drawer + Pagination
Anti_Patterns: Horizontal scroll without sticky columns + Unconfirmed destructive bulk actions + Full page reload on search

Recommended_Pattern: Kanban / Task List or Editor + Quick-Add Bar + Detail Inspector
Typography_Mood: Clean + Compact readable typography (Proportional or Serif for long-form notes)
Key_Effects: Drag-and-drop reordering with keyboard alternative + Optimistic checkbox toggle + Auto-save indicator + Keyboard shortcut badges
Anti_Patterns: Slow interaction latency + Modal dialog for every tiny edit + Cluttered icons + Loss of uncommitted note text

Recommended_Pattern: Prompt Workspace / Chat Stream + Action Bar + Model Settings
Color_Mood: Sleek slate + Accent indigo/violet (#6366F1) + Semantic status
Typography_Mood: Modern readable sans + Monospace code blocks with syntax highlighting
Key_Effects: Token streaming typewriter animation + Copy-to-clipboard feedback + Stop generation button
Anti_Patterns: Blocking entire screen during AI inference + Missing error retry + Plain text code blocks without copy button

Recommended_Pattern: Documentation Layout / Sidebar Tree + Breadcrumb + Sticky Table of Contents
Style_Priority: Minimalism & Swiss Style + Monospace Code Accent
Color_Mood: Dark slate / Obsidian theme + Vibrant code syntax highlighting
Typography_Mood: Inter/Geist for prose + JetBrains Mono/Fira Code for snippets
Key_Effects: One-click copy code + Active heading highlight on scroll + Cmd+K search modal
Anti_Patterns: Broken deep links + Non-copyable code snippets + Unscrollable code blocks

Recommended_Pattern: Account Overview / Balance Hero + Transaction List + Transfer Modal
Color_Mood: Trust navy/emerald green + Muted background + Red/Green status badges
Typography_Mood: Tabular figures for currency + Serious professional sans-serif
Key_Effects: Sensitive data toggle (show/hide balances) + Instant transfer verification + OTP modal
Anti_Patterns: Ambiguous currency symbols + Missing confirmation steps on transfers + Exposing sensitive balances in public mode

Recommended_Pattern: Case Study Showcase / Bento Grid + Project Modals + Contact Footer
Color_Mood: Sophisticated monochrome + Single expressive accent color
Typography_Mood: Expressive display heading + Refined body typography
Key_Effects: Smooth scroll + Project card hover zoom + Interactive live demos
Anti_Patterns: Laggy scroll-jacking + Huge unoptimized images + Missing contact email link

Recommended_Pattern: Curriculum Player / Lesson Tree + Video/Article Viewer + Step Progress
Color_Mood: Friendly blue/teal primary + Warm reward accents + High-contrast reader text
Typography_Mood: Highly legible reading typography + Generous line height (1.6)
Key_Effects: Progress completion bars + Quiz feedback celebration + Lesson checklist marks
Anti_Patterns: Cluttered lesson view + Unsaved quiz progress + Cramped reading text on mobile

Recommended_Pattern: Editorial Feed / Featured Story + Article / Video View + Sticky Mini-Player
Color_Mood: Monochrome paper reading surface + Brand accent + Dark media player dock
Typography_Mood: Editorial serif/proportional sans for headlines + Crisp sans for body
Key_Effects: Persistent bottom mini-player + Reading progress indicator + Bookmark toggle
Anti_Patterns: Autoplaying sound without user interaction + Intrusive popups blocking content

Recommended_Pattern: Faceted Search & Card Grid + Calendar/Time Picker Modal + Map Drawer
Style_Priority: Clean Modern Cards + Visual Local Showcase
Color_Mood: Warm inviting brand primary + Green available status + Neutral background
Typography_Mood: Friendly + Clear location, pricing, and time typography
Key_Effects: Time slot selection button + Filter drawer transition + Booking summary checkout
Anti_Patterns: Hidden pricing until final checkout step + Ambiguous availability status + Full page reload on filter change
